theme: A whimsical and rustic Nordic folktale world, illustrated in the style of traditional Scandinavian woodcuts. The setting features snowy landscapes, dense forests of tall pine trees, and quaint rural scenes. The characters, such as a clever fox and a naive bear, are depicted with exaggerated, expressive features. The mood is playful and slightly mischievous, with an underlying moral tone. Artistic elements include detailed textures reminiscent of wood engravings, muted earth tones with occasional pops of color, and a balance between light-hearted humor and the harshness of nature.
